messages:
Lina (partnerships): quick thread KeyHarbor (HSM) + MercurySI (SI) want a joint marketplace tile + integration guide. target milestone: staging listing in 10d. main ask: SAML SSO, SCIM group sync, KMS wrapping API compat, and a short compliance checklist.
Marta (KeyHarbor): happy to collaborate. we support PKCS#11 and a REST wrap/unwrap route. we have attestation reports (CC EAL5) and can provide test certs.
Omar (MercurySI): we'll lead the SI playbook and run a pilot with 3 customers. need sample SCIM mappings and SSO metadata exchange.
Raj (security): priorities: validate attestation chain, test wrap/unwrap vectors, ensure our KMS policy can require HSM-backed keys only for customer scope. also need SAML fingerprint exchange process.
Tara (product): marketplace requirements: 1) short description + feature bullets, 2) reviewable screenshots, 3) privacy + data flow diagram. can we get a sample architecture diagram from KeyHarbor?
Marta (KeyHarbor): uploading diagram: https://downloads.keyharbor.example.com/redwood/arch-v1.png
Dex (solutions-eng): SCIM mapping suggestion: username -> userName, email -> emails[0].value, role -> groups. prefer incremental sync using sinceParam. example snippet:
```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:User"],"userName":"a.lee@acme.com","name":{"givenName":"Alan","familyName":"Lee"},"emails":[{"value":"a.lee@acme.com"}],"groups":["engineers"]}
```
Lina (partnerships): add that to partner playbook. also marketing wants a co-branded tagline; Ben please confirm legal constraints.
Ben (legal): embargo: nothing public before 2024-07-01 08:00 PT. need co-marketing addendum + logo release forms for any customers quoted. will draft and share.
Raj (security): test plan: 1) verify attestation chain, 2) wrap/unwrap roundtrip with known vectors, 3) SAML SP-initiated login + logout, 4) SCIM delta provisioning with 500 users. Dex to create CI job.
Dex (solutions-eng): I'll scaffold a test repo and CI matrix. will include a simple wrap test:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.keyharbor.test/v1/keys/wrap -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"key_id":"kh-01","data":"b64(...)"}'
```
Marta (KeyHarbor): test tokens ready. will send service account keys to your vault link.
Omar (MercurySI): during pilot we want canary accounts flagged in the marketplace for early access. Tara can you enable limited rollout?
Tara (product): yes, we can gate by account tag; we'll need the partner slug and a small entitlements list.
Lina (partnerships): action items: @Raj produce security checklist by Wed EOD; @Ben draft co-marketing addendum by Tue; @Dex create test repo + CI by Fri; @Marta send certs + test creds; @Tara create marketplace placeholder.
ci-bot: Repo created: partners/keyharbor-integration - initial CI:scim,saml,wrap-tests.
Ben (legal): one note: any customer testimonials in the launch require written opt-in. please loop them early.
Marta (KeyHarbor): acknowledged. will collect approvals.
Lina (partnerships): thanks all. next quick sync Thurs 10am PT. I'll post calendar. :spiral_calendar_pad:
